heading: About the notice you served
paragraphs: You will now be asked questions about the notice you served to the defendants.
A notice is a formal communication informing the defendants that you intend to repossess the property, like form 3A.
bullets: the date you served the notice
afterBullets: You will also be asked to upload a copy of the notice.
The defendant will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
